title: PulsarMLX Console volatile fields
rule: specs/022-console-serving-parity/contracts/parity-ledger.md section 1.1: everything the server sends is observable unless it is listed here. Each listed field is replaced by its class placeholder only after its class check passes, so a field that fails the check is still a difference. Header names, their case and their positions stay observable; of Date and Server only the values are volatile (tasks.md R29). Names are the donor's, as observed on the reference side before the rename map applies. A json-key location applies to a member of a JSON object in a body, a stream event, an NDJSON line or a file, at any depth, and parent means the object is itself the value of that member; a file-name or log-text pattern uses only the holes <host>, <port>, <pid>, <hex>, <hexN> (exactly N digits), <rand> (eight characters of a-z, 0-9 and _) and, in a log-text pattern of class num, <num> (digits and dots; only the holes are replaced, the text around them stays observable). Read and checked by console-conformance::scenario::VolatileFields; applied by console-conformance::normalize (CNF-04), which refuses an entry it cannot apply. Reviewed by CNF-04 on 2026-11-15 against the donor's response builders: every field cites the donor line that produces the value.

classes.check: the prefix then exactly the listed number of lower-case hex digits, as a whole JSON string written without escapes (or the hole of a file-name pattern, whose prefix is the literal before the hole); numbered by first appearance across the whole scenario, per prefix, so cross-references stay checkable
an integer token (digits only) of seconds since the epoch within the run window

classes.placeholder: <epoch-s> for digits only, <epoch-s:f> with a fraction
classes.check: a number token of digits with an optional fraction and no exponent, seconds since the epoch within the run window; the placeholder keeps whether it had a fraction

the form Python's isoformat writes in UTC with +00:00 replaced by Z (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, then nothing or exactly six fraction digits, then Z), a valid date within the run window; the window end is extended only for a field the scenario names

classes.placeholder: <num> for digits only, <num:f> with a fraction, <num:e> with an exponent
classes.check: a non-negative number token (or Prometheus sample value, or log-text <num> hole, of the same form); the placeholder keeps whether it was written as an integer, a fraction or with an exponent; null, strings and negative values are compared exactly

the header is present once, at the same position; its name, the name's case and its position are compared exactly. A Date value is an IMF-fixdate as Python's email.utils.formatdate(usegmt=True) writes it (Www, DD Mon YYYY HH:MM:SS GMT, English names, a weekday that matches the date) within the run window; any other listed value is a non-empty string
a positive integer of at most ten digits without a leading zero
an integer from 1 to 65535, written without a leading zero, equal to the port the side's server listens on; any other port is compared exactly
a path under the side's temporary directory; only the directory part is replaced, the rest of the path stays observable (its file name takes the file rename on the reference side)

fields.note: Written by Python's http.server send_response, which every response helper calls: _json (serve/server.py:5457-5463), _sse (6463-6474) and _ndjson_start (5628-5631).
The donor's value names Python's http.server and the Python version; the console's value is pulsar-console/<version> (deviation P-1), asserted by API-02's own tests.
Anthropic message ids and Responses message items.
Only generated ids: deterministic ids such as call_loop_guard (serve/server.py:4002) do not match and stay observable.
uuid4().hex[:12], in the vision temporary directory. The path reaches the engine in its GENI line (the engine tape), which no location kind covers yet; as listed it applies to observed file names.
uuid4().hex[:12], in the vision temporary directory. The path reaches the engine in its GENI line (the engine tape), which no location kind covers yet; as listed it applies to observed file names.
A resumable web answer's file is named after its chat completion id, which takes the same placeholder as the id in the stream (written only with disk persistence on, PRIV-1).
The Ollama-shaped NDJSON stamps: each chunk's _stamp() and the final line of an aborted stream.
GET /v1/status (integer), the context reload state, the model restart state, the updater's state and the model pull's snapshot (fractions).
The context reload state and the updater's failed state.

The last line of a resumable answer's file: the time the answer ended. The location has no parent, so a _done member at any depth is normalized; the donor writes it only there (a top-level-only location is a lead request).

The Monitor's totals, a loading model's start in /api/ps and the savings ledger's start (whole and per model). The savings ledger persists across runs: a since from an earlier run fails the window check and is compared exactly.

GET /metrics' time, the peak decode's time, each finished request's time, the deletion result's time and the time member of the switch and delete notes written to the models directory. Also the time the server stamps on each STAT line of the GLM engine (the tiers of GET /metrics).
The stamp of the last request's timings in GET /v1/status.

/api/ps: the idle-unload time, (last request or start) plus the limit. Without idle unload the donor writes the constant 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, which fails the class check and is compared exactly. The idle limit puts the stamp after the run, so a scenario that observes it extends the window end for this field by that limit (SideContext::extend_window).
/api/tags and /api/show: the modification time of a model file the harness writes at run time. Without that time the donor writes the epoch, which fails the class check and is compared exactly.
/api/context: the engine's last load time, rounded to tenths of a second.

GET /status (top level) and the live block of GET /metrics: the running request's elapsed time. The location has no parent, so an elapsed_s member at any depth is normalized (it replaces the former live-elapsed entry, which this one made redundant); a top-level-only location is a lead request.
GET /status while an answer is written, at the top level. The location has no parent, so the member is normalized at any depth; a top-level-only location is a lead request.
As status-tokens-per-s.
GET /api/update: when the last update check ran (null before the first, compared exactly).
The model pull's snapshot: the download rate.
Each request's, each response's timings and the totals.
The counts of the same object (cache_n, prompt_n, predicted_n, draft_n) are not volatile.
The donor's metric name; its console name is the renamed prefix (rename-map.json, naming.md section 3.9).
GET and POST /api/port, and the switch note.
The line printed after each request: the elapsed time and the rate are volatile; the token count before the pattern, the finish reason and the rest of the line stay observable.
The progress line while a prompt is read. How many progress lines appear depends on timing (serve/server.py:3796-3798), which no value normalization absorbs: raised to the lead.
The progress line while an answer is written; the token counts before the pattern stay observable. Its count depends on timing, as log-progress-prompt.
The heartbeat while the engine starts; its count depends on timing, as log-progress-prompt.

location.pattern: this request waited <num> s for the engine

fields.note: Printed when a request waited long for its turn; the number of requests behind it stays observable.
Written by the GLM fake engine when it keeps its conversation on QUIT.

A model file's path in the models list and /api/show, the items of a delete plan, and the models directory in the storage block of GET /metrics; the harness writes these under the side's temporary directory. Only a value under that directory is replaced. The storage block's free and total figures are machine readings, raised with the hardware readings to the lead.
A model pack's folder in the models list and in maya.folder of /api/show. A delete-plan item's folder member is a boolean (serve/models.py:1357) and is not a string, so it is compared exactly.
The resolved run-config path in the switch and delete notes.

tempfile.mkdtemp under the temporary directory. No donor log line prints this directory: the path reaches the engine in the GENI line (the engine tape), which no location kind covers yet. As listed it applies to log lines only, as {{tmp}}/<prefix><rand>; the console's prefix is proposed (rename-map.json, tmp-prefix), so it is not renamed.
